# xcelsior_serverless_endpoint (Resource)

A serverless inference endpoint, billed per worker-second.

Created through an endpoint plan approved like an instance launch plan: by the token's spend envelope, or by a person within the provider's `approval_timeout`. The plan approves one hour at `max_workers`. Only `name` is updated in place. Worker counts and every other argument replace the endpoint, because raising them in place would add spend that no plan approved.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "xcelsior_serverless_endpoint" "chat" {
  name        = "chat"
  model_ref   = "Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct"
  gpu_tier    = "RTX 4090"
  min_workers = 0 # nothing billed while idle
  max_workers = 2

  env = {
    HF_TOKEN = var.hf_token
  }
}

variable "hf_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `gpu_tier` (String) GPU model each worker runs on.
- `name` (String) Endpoint name. Renamed in place.

### Optional

- `docker_image` (String) Custom container image.
- `env` (Map of String, Sensitive) Environment for the workers. Stored encrypted; the API never returns it, so drift in it is not detected.
- `gpu_count` (Number) GPUs per worker, 1 to 8.
- `idle_timeout_sec` (Number) Seconds a worker idles before it scales down, 60 to 86400.
- `max_concurrency` (Number) Requests one worker serves at once, 1 to 256.
- `max_workers` (Number) Worker ceiling, 1 to 32. The plan approves one hour at this many workers.
- `min_workers` (Number) Workers kept warm, 0 to 32. Warm workers bill while idle; set 0 to pay nothing while idle.
- `mode` (String) `preset` (a managed engine serving `model_ref`, the API default) or a custom-container mode with `docker_image`.
- `model_ref` (String) Model to serve, such as a Hugging Face repo id.
- `region` (String)
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `launch_plan_id` (String)
- `status` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import xcelsior_serverless_endpoint.chat <endpoint-id>
```
